lines.say: Hic! That sound is your vocal cords slamming shut.
lines.caption: Hic

lines.say: But it starts lower, in your diaphragm, the dome of muscle under your lungs.
lines.caption: Diaphragm

lines.say: Eat too fast or gulp a fizzy drink, and the nerves that run it get irritated.
lines.caption: Irritated

lines.say: The diaphragm twitches, you suck in air, and the vocal cords snap closed. Hic!
lines.caption: Snap

lines.say: Babies even hiccup before they're born.
lines.caption: Babies

lines.say: And one farmer, Charles Osborne, had hiccups for 68 years.
lines.caption: 68 years
